closed: Common areas are closed every Tuesday for cleaning and maintenance.

pool.title: Swimming pools
pool.hours: There are 2 swimming pools. Opening hours: 8am to 8pm. The use of a towel is mandatory on the sunbeds.
pool.bags: It is not allowed to enter the swimming pool area with luggage and backpacks (you can use the building’s luggage storage service if needed).

jacuzzi.title: Jacuzzi
jacuzzi.text: To use the jacuzzi, you must book your turn by scanning the QR code available on the 4th floor.
